notes: Wheel history: sha256 099f8dcd...e494e (built against torch 2.7.1+cu126) was SUPERSEDED by sha256 e462074c...2763 (rebuilt against torch 2.11.0+cu130, the lane runtime). Reason: torch ABI - the torch 2.7.1 build exported c10_cuda_check_implementation with an 'int' 5th arg while torch 2.11.0+cu130 defines the 'unsigned int' variant, causing an undefined-symbol import failure (see install_evidence). The rebuild resolves the ABI mismatch; the old evidence files are preserved as-is to document the journey.
